changed.words: +join = spatial join (attribute transfer): each point in layerId takes properties from the joinLayerId polygon containing it (collisions prefixed, unmatched points carry NO joined fields, zero overlap is a typed rejection). merge = append two same-geometry-class layers into one dataset with a per-row source column (schemas never null-filled; class mismatch is a typed failure). near = nearest-neighbor distance columns (great-circle meters, stated — never presented as road distance). dissolve = true polygon union per attribute group (missing values form their own group; partial sums reported).
